entries.title: Job 36:3
segments: From afar; from without and beyond the range of common thought.

entries.title: Job 36:4
segments: Perfect in knowledge; this Elihu applies to himself.  He uses the word perfect in the sense of upright or sincere, meaning that his is one who will utter what he knows in sincerity, avoiding all sophistry and false reasoning.

entries.title: Job 36:9
segments:
He showeth them their work; their evil work: this Elihu states as the object of their affliction. 
 
  Exceeded; that their transgressions have been great. 
 
In speaking for God, men should be careful to declare only his truth, and in such a manner as shall honor him and be useful to their fellow men.

entries.title: Job 36:10
segments: The design of God in afflictions, is to lead men to forsake their sins and obey him.  If they do this, he will in due time remove their trials and bestow upon them the riches of his mercy; if they do not, they will treasure up wrath and perish without hope.

entries.title: Job 36:12
segments: Without knowledge; that is, from want of knowledge.  Because they did not understand and make a right use of God's discipline.

entries.title: Job 36:13
segments: They cry not; they do not call upon God in affliction.

entries.title: Job 36:14
segments: Their life is among the unclean; their life perishes by a premature and base death, like that of the unclean.  The word rendered "unclean" means Sodomites.

entries.title: Job 36:15
segments:
Openeth their ears; to the instructions which his dealings are suited to impart. 
 
  In oppression; in a time of affliction and by means of it.

entries.title: Job 36:17
segments: Fulfilled the judgment of the wicked; had acted as they do, and been afflicted accordingly.  Elihu does not mean to charge Job with having been a hypocrite addicted to gross sins, as his three friends had done, but rather with behaving like the wicked under his afflictions, and therefore failing to receive deliverance.

entries.title: Job 36:18
segments: When men have once passed the boundaries of probation, they are unalterably fixed in their final unchanging state.

entries.title: Job 36:20
segments: The night; the night of death.
When people are cut off in their place; when the successive generations of men vanish each from their place.

entries.title: Job 36:21
segments:
Regard not iniquity; indulge not thyself in it.  It is the iniquity of impatience and rebellion against God's dealings with him, that Elihu charges upon Job. 
 
  This; iniquity. 
 
  Rather than affliction; thou preferrest to spend thy time in murmuring against God, rather than in patient submission to his rod.

entries.title: Job 36:23
segments: Who hath enjoined him; pointed out to God what he should do.

entries.title: Job 36:24
segments: Which men behold; or, which men celebrate; namely, all righteous men.

entries.title: Job 36:26
segments: The character and ways of God are in many respects unsearchable, past finding out.  It is our wisdom and duty to bow submissively before him, feeling that though clouds and darkness are round about him, justice and judgment, righteousness and truth are the habitation of his throne.

entries.title: Job 36:27
segments:
Maketh small; or draweth up, that is, in vapor, that he may pour them down again in rain. 
 
  Vapor; this word here signifies the mass of clouds out of which the rain falls.

entries.title: Job 36:29
segments:
The spreadings of the clouds; the way in which God spreads forth his clouds in the firmament above. 
 
  The noise of his tabernacle; the thunder that comes from his tabernacle in the clouds.

entries.title: Job 36:30
segments:
His light; lightning. 
 
  Upon it; the cloud. 
 
  The bottom of the sea; he covereth with water.

entries.title: Job 36:31
segments: By them; clouds, rain, thunder, and lightning.

entries.title: Job 36:32
segments: With clouds--cometh betwixt; this verse may be thus rendered: He covereth his hands with light, [lightning;] and gives it a charge upon its mark, [the object it shall strike;] or, as some prefer, gives it a charge against the opposer; that is, the man that is rebellious against God.

entries.title: Job 36:33
segments:
The noise thereof showeth concerning it; or, his noise [thunder] shows concerning him; that is, announces his approach in a tempest. 
 
  The cattle also; the cattle also, by their actions, give signs. 
 
  The vapor; the mass of rising clouds.
